baseline_coherence.note: COMPREHENSION gate — fraction of baseline responses that are coherent (not gibberish/empty). Low variant refusal is only evidence of script-anchoring where variant coherence is HIGH.

cell_flip_rates_gated_vs_raw.note: gated = flip AND coherent transition (genuine, on-topic). raw = old definition (counts gibberish as compliance).

cell_flip_rates_conditional.note: flips ÷ pairs-with-room; room = baseline-refused (ablation) or baseline-complied (addition)

same_target_contrasts.note: native-dir vs variant-dir on the SAME target (mode-robust; avoids baseline-saturation). Primary = the one whose target has room under this mode.

headline.asymmetry_pp_caveat: FF−RF is still baseline-saturation-confounded; prefer same_target_contrasts.primary_contrast_pp
